Spellthrone — the wyrms

The hounds are retired — the quadrupeds never read right. Each court’s Exclusive is a serpent now: coiled plate over a living core, a flat wedge head, a forked tongue that darts. Same scale side by side, slowly turntabling. These are the Cinderwyrm and the Rimewyrm — the courts’ Exclusives in the game as of v3.13.

The Court Exclusives — the wyrms

One serpent per court, built plate by plate over a glowing core: 46 segments, a hooded neck, a flat spade head with the eyes riding proud — and a forked tongue on its own hinge, darting in the FX loop. The Frost wyrm carries its heart crystal proud at its chest — the ice wolf’s one lesson worth keeping.

CINDERWYRM — The Coiled Furnace · Ember

Two stacked coils of charcoal stone plate with magma glowing in every seam, rising into a hooded S-neck and a flat wedge head — no horns, no muzzle, no dog in it. Amber eyes ride the upper flanks; a dark-red forked tongue flicks out twice a loop and is gone.

RIMEWYRM — The Glacier Serpent · Frost

The same serpent in ice: translucent blue plates over a cyan glacier core, a crest of crystal shards down the neck, shards fanning the hood — and the great heart crystal set proud in its chest, pulsing slow. Its sway runs heavier than Ember’s, and snow motes drift through its FX.
